_about: Chai's settings: everything about the game that is a number, a word's id, an art id or a choice. The game's code (js/games/chai/) holds none of these. The numbers are old chai's, as played on 17 Nov 2026.

order._about: Who orders and what each can ask for, by level: every ask drawn at random for each person from what the level allows. No person has a usual order (Zafar, 24 Nov: the orders stay as they are, each level's rules for making them kept).
order.speaker: each

asks._about: Level 1 always asks milk; from level 2, where milk is a choice, it is asked about half the time (Zafar, 24 Nov)

teach._words: while half or full is new, each is asked for by one person, who is drawn at random each round (Zafar, 24 Nov: not always Nana)

heat._about: Each level's heat: how fast the ring fills (share of the ring a second) and where its green sits. From the green on it climbs at the kitchen's slower share. foamShare: past the green, milky chai foams up for this share of the way to boiling over, then spills (black tea spills straight away). milkInWater: milk in the water before the tea leaves, how far the pan shows milky over plain water. sinkSecs, sinkHalf: as the fire is lit the spoonfuls settle half into the tea over its first sinkSecs (still seen, semi-submerged, as if infusing), and stay so until the boil takes them the rest of the way (Zafar, 21 and 22 Nov: "maybe half a second"; "half faded in after 0.4 secs of lighting"; "They're still visible, but they're like ... semi-submerged. And then eventually they disappear as it starts bubbling").

row._about: The bottom row: two fixed groups, then the spices (what was asked for, with the level's decoys from the pool, shuffled). The lookalike stands beside the sugar's own jar at the levels that have one. always: the things every dish needs, asked for or not. once: the things that go into a pan once, the water, the milk and the tea (Zafar, 19 Nov); every other thing goes in up to the kit's most of one (data/kit.json levels.mostOfOne). spoon: which of the game's spoons a kind of thing travels on.

motion._about: How long things take, in milliseconds, and their shapes. row: a bottle or carton flying to the pan, tipping, pouring and coming back (the cook rules count these as one move in flight). rowShape: its arcs in design px, its tilt in degrees, and when its sound starts. spoon: a spoonful's flight and stir. take: the pan lifting over its glass, emptying (for each half: 560 ms, a little quicker than 700 so the glass's frames come closer together and it fills more smoothly, Zafar, 22 Nov; a fade between the frames flashed) and going back. takeBackMs: a spoonful going back to its jar. carry: the pan over its glass: how much bigger it is drawn when lifted, the gap between rims as a share of the pan's, and the arc of the lift. into: where a bottle pours from (in vessel radii from the pan's middle), the stir's circle and the spoon's length (in contents radii), and the cross-fade as a thing lands. carry.swapAt, backAt: how far through the lift and the way back the pan's picture changes. carry.holdRoom: how far above its rim's middle the lifted pan's picture reaches, in rim radii; margin: design px kept clear of the view's edge.

wordMoment._about: Half and full cannot be shown by a picture of a thing, so they are shown once before the kitchen, while either word is still new to the child. act: what shows each word, the game's choice (the kitchen's pour: a kettle pours each glass to its measure; the kit's pictures, its sides drawn as data/moments/ files are; or none: no word moment). fills: how far each word's glass is poured. art: the scene's pictures. scene: the counter picture (the row its counter line is on, its shape, the span of it drawn across the play area, and the lowest the line may sit). vessel: the kettle (where its spout is in its picture, its width in glasses, and how far it is tipped back when not pouring). tea: where the tea's inside starts and ends in the full glass's picture.

lines._about: Nani's lines for this game's own steps, as meanings for the language engine. standing: shown before the first step. use: a thing with its own line; any other thing takes the kitchen's line. take: the ready pan into the glass, one glass at a time, so always Mum's one-person line, "his or her glass", which follows the glass, right for a man or a woman, at every level (Zafar, 19 Nov); takeAgain: a full glass's second pour.

teaches._about: What this game carries, as data: the single source for the word counter. id: the word's id in the language engine, or a row of the grammar ladder. role: primary (the game cannot be won without understanding it), secondary (heard and used, not deciding), tertiary (heard in passing). level: where it enters. Written from what old chai really says on 17 Nov 2026; the roles are the lead builder's reading, for Zafar to correct.

art._about: Chai's pictures, by art id. pan: one pan from exactly above in its looks, all painted on one base (art run C1), so each is placed by the same rim; over-milky and over-black are the pan boiling over. over: pictures laid over the pan's contents (none now: each boil is a whole look of the pan). onSurface: a spoonful's mark in the pan, by what went in: a teaspoonful of the thing as it lies on the tea from straight above, with its wet contact, until the boil takes it; its states milky and black are it painted lying in that tea (art run C6), its default on its own (art run C5; Zafar, 20 Nov: "The items going into the pan should be different, they should be made for the pan and look better"). emptying, filling: the six frames of a pour, pan and glass, milky and black, made by the cutter from the full and emptied pictures (Zafar, 19 Nov). dishCard: the dish's own card, one plain glass of chai for every order, so it never gives away milk or none (Zafar, 19 Nov). amountCard: the side-on glass for half and full, milky or black. A ref ending "#*" is every state of the piece, in order (the frames).

vessel._about: The pan on its burner. reach: how far the handle's end is from the rim's centre, in rim radii (the kitchen spaces pans so a handle clears the next). rimSrc, innerSrc: the rim's and the contents' radius in the pictures' own px. box: the box the pan is drawn in, in rim radii (the handle and the picture's own shadow fit inside). shadow: its soft shadow's size and drop, in vessel radii. overlay: how much wider than the contents a boil's picture is laid. marks: the spoonfuls lying on the tea: each one's width a share of the contents' radius (size; the pictures are all cut at one scale, sources/art/chai-c5/cut_c5.py, so one size: 0.7, the square about a third of the tea's width, the spoonful in it 0.71 to 0.96 of that; the reviewer, 21 Nov: 0.45 read too small at a phone's size); spots: where each lies, in the order they go in, [a share of the contents' radius from the middle, degrees round], a ring at half the radius with every next one across the pan from the last, so they never pile up in the middle and the outermost square reaches 0.85 of the radius, inside the tea (an in-tea picture's square is wider, its ring of tea fading out well inside it); past the last spot the list again, turned by again degrees; alpha: how strongly they show; wet: how each lies in the tea rather than on it (the reviewer, 21 Nov: 'stuck on top'), made by the kit (js/shared/made-pictures.js wet): its own soft dark ring under it (ring: blur, dx, dy as shares of its picture's width, alpha) and the tea's colour over its lower part (tint: from this share of the thing's own height down to its foot, up to alpha), liquid the colour for each look of the pan (sampled from the pan's pictures; other: the black tea's), texture the working copy's size in px; inTea: in milky chai or black tea (by: the pan's look, which tea; water with the leaves only colouring it keeps the made ring) a spoonful is its own picture painted lying in that tea, with a soft ring of it (art run C6; Zafar, 21 Nov: "having them in the tea would make them look better"), drawn grow times as wide (its square has room for the ring; the thing itself the same size), the made wet ring and tint only in water or a dry pan. They fade as the boil takes them. dip: the small settle when something lands.

serving._about: The serving spot: the wooden tray with a well for each glass. wells: each well's middle as shares of the tray; wellD: a well's width as a share of the tray's; aspect: the tray picture's height over its width. halves: the pours a glass takes to be full, a half being one. A resting half glass is filling frame 4, a full one frame 6. art: the tray (base) and a dish before anything is in it (empty).

sounds._about: Which of the kit's sounds this game's own moments play.

greeting._about: The greeting slot: the person who orders first greets the child on the first meeting of the day, with the right answer and one wrong one offered alike. The lines are the kit's.
